This section contains documentation of output variables in a format that is easy to search and print.
The output variables are ordered alphabetically by name.
There are no subsections, just a long list of output variables that Tax-Calculator is programmed to calculate.
: After tax income is equal to expanded_income minus combined
: Deduction for payment of qualified auto loan interest
: Government cost of all benefits received by tax unit
: Consumption value of all benefits received by tax unit, which is included in expanded_income
: Net capital gain or loss after loss limitation (Sch D line 21)
: Social security (OASDI) benefits included in AGI
: Total of all ‘above the line’ income adjustments to get AGI
: Deductible part of self-employment tax (Sch 1 line 15)
: Itemized deductions after limitations (zero for non-itemizers)
: Tax amount from Sch X,Y,Z tables
: Tax on lump-sum distributions (Form 4972), which is not modeled and so is zero
: Total (regular + AMT) income tax liability before credits (equals taxbc plus c09600)
: Total non-refundable credits used to reduce positive tax liability
: Nonrefundable credit for child and dependent care expenses from Form 2441
: Schedule R credit for the elderly and the disabled
: Education tax credits non-refundable amount from Form 8863 (includes c87668)
: Retirement savings contributions credit (Sch 3 line 4) limited by tax liability
: Residential clean energy credit (Sch 3 line 5a) limited by tax liability
: Foreign tax credit (Sch 3 line 1) limited by tax liability
: General business credit (Sch 3 line 6a) limited by tax liability
: Prior-year minimum tax credit (Sch 3 line 6b) limited by tax liability
: Other nonrefundable credits (Sch 3 line 6z) limited by tax liability
: Income tax liability (including othertaxes) after non-refundable credits are used, but before refundable credits are applied
: American Opportunity Credit refundable amount from Form 8863
: Sch A: Medical expenses deducted (component of pre-limitation c21060 total)
: Sch A: State and local taxes plus real estate taxes deducted (component of pre-limitation c21060 total)
: Sch A: Interest deducted (component of pre-limitation c21060 total)
: Sch A: Charity contributions deducted (component of pre-limitation c21060 total)
: Sch A: Net casualty or theft loss deducted (component of pre-limitation c21060 total)
: Sch A: Net limited miscellaneous deductions deducted (component of pre-limitation c21060 total)
: Itemized deductions that are phased out
: Itemized deductions before phase-out (zero for non-itemizers)
: Net capital gain or loss before loss limitation (Sch D line 16)
: Child and dependent care expenses capped by policy (not by earnings)
: Earned income tax credit (Form 1040 line 27) after all eligibility limits
: American Opportunity Credit non-refundable amount from Form 8863 (included in c07230)
: Refundable credit for child and dependent care expenses from Form 2441
: CTC and ODC not absorbed by tax liability (Sch 8812 line 12 minus line 14)
: Sum of iitax and payrolltax and lumpsum_tax
: Uniform random number used in EITC/ACTC claiming logic, which implies correlated claimning behavior across different credits
: Reform-only new refundable child tax credit after phase-in and phase-out
: Portion of total CTC amount that is nonrefundable
: Portion of total CTC amount that is refundable
: Total CTC amount (c07220 + c11070 + odc + ctc_new)
: Qualified dividends plus net capital gain (Sch D Tax Worksheet line 10)
: Sch D Tax Worksheet line 13 (zero when no preferential-rate income)
: Sch D Tax Worksheet line 14 (zero when no preferential-rate income)
: Taxable income taxed at ordinary rates (Sch D Tax Worksheet line 21)
: separate tax on long-term capital gains and qualified dividends
: Earned income for filing unit: wages plus sey minus c03260 (floored at zero)
: Earned income for taxpayer: wages plus SE income minus deductible SE tax
: Earned income for spouse: wages plus SE income minus deductible SE tax
: 1 if phase-outs use stepped tax-form formulas; 0 if smoothed for sensible MTRs
: Broad income measure that includes benefit_value_total
: Total federal individual income tax liability; appears as INCTAX variable in tc CLI minimal output
: Reform-only exclusion of qualified dividends and capital gains from AGI
: Lumpsum (or head) tax; appears as LSTAX variable in tc CLI minimal output
: Marginal income tax rate (in percentage terms) on extra taxpayer earnings (e00200p)
: Marginal payroll tax rate (in percentage terms) on extra taxpayer earnings (e00200p)
: Net Investment Income Tax from Form 8960
: Amount of UBI benefit excluded from AGI
: 2 when MARS is 2 (married filing jointly); otherwise 1
: Other taxes: sum of niit, e09700, e09800 and e09900 (included in c09200)
: Total (employee + employer) payroll tax liability; appears as PAYTAX variable in tc CLI minimal output (payrolltax = ptax_was)
: Additional Medicare Tax from Form 8959 (included in othertaxes and iitax)

: Taxpayer’s employer share of OASDI+HI FICA payroll tax on wages and salaries; excludes self-employment tax (which has no employer share) and is therefore invariant under the soi_iitax bucketing switch

: Spouse’s employer share of OASDI+HI FICA payroll tax on wages and salaries; excludes self-employment tax (which has no employer share) and is therefore invariant under the soi_iitax bucketing switch
: Employee + employer OASDI FICA tax plus self-employment tax
: Employee + employer OASDI + HI FICA tax
: Recovery Rebate Credit, from American Rescue Plan Act of 2021
: Deduction for elderly head and/or spouse
: Self-employment tax (included in othertaxes and iitax)
: Total self-employment income (Sch C, Sch F, and K-1 box 14) for filing unit
: Amount of UBI benefit included in AGI
: Regular tax on regular taxable income before credits
: Universal Basic Income benefit for filing unit
: Modified AGI used to compute taxable Social Security benefits
: Gross income excluding Social Security benefits, before adjustments
